title: Meridian Financial adjudication case
description: A case is Chapter 5 Definition 3's triple (id, rules, facts) plus the procedural, narrative and expectation fields a conformance corpus needs.

rules.description: The provisions the change touches. Empty means the evaluator engaged nothing, which is the docket's null route.

facts.description: A factor-style description of the material facts, in the CATO tradition. Every name is drawn from the constitution's factor vocabulary except contextual observations prefixed ctx_.

ts.description: Ordinal arrival time. Cases are chronological and the store grows across them.

contest_to.description: A social input, not a decision of the architecture. 0 uncontested; 2 or 3 resolved at that automated instance; 4 escalation exhausted and the risk owner acted.

scenario.description: Narrative colour. Not part of the formal model and never read by the engine.

engine.description: Construction hints the reference engine reads: premise, cites, class role.

meta.description: Why the case exists, and category-specific expectations a human reader needs.

asserts.description: Axioms (A1-A9) and conformance checks (VC-*) this case exercises.

polarity.description: Declared polarity, after sigstore-conformance. must_fail means the case must be denied.

expect.description: Computed from an executed trace, never authored. An independent replay must reproduce it exactly (VC-01, VC-02).

controlling.description: A record id, null where nothing controlled, or the distinct value none_tie where survivors deadlocked. none_tie is not an absence of authority.
